{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing any non-numeric characters
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
channel_revenue_sorted = channel_revenue.sort_values(by='revenue', ascending=False)

# Extract the top channel
top_channel = channel_revenue_sorted.iloc[0]['channel']
revenue_top_channel = channel_revenue_sorted.iloc[0]['revenue']

# Print the result
print(f"Top channel: {top_channel}")
print(f"Revenue: {revenue_top_channel}")"}
